;Politics and elections
*[[British Columbia electoral reform referendum, 2018]]
**The [[Canada|Canadian]] province of [[British Columbia]] begins a [[Postal voting|postal ballot]] to determine whether to maintain the current [[first-past-the-post voting]] system or switch to a form of [[proportional representation]] for their provincial elections.  [https://elections.bc.ca/referendum/ (Elections BC)]
*[[Transgender rights]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] through the [[United States Department of Health and Human Services]] plans to include a legal definition of gender in the federal civil rights [[Title IX]] law. The proposed alteration to the law would define gender as an unchangeable anatomical and genetic condition determined at birth.  Members of the [[LGBT]] community plan to contest the move, which they state would largely end protections for [[transgender]] Americans. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/10/21/us/politics/transgender-trump-administration-sex-definition.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.npr.org/2018/10/22/659553583/trans-people-say-they-wontbeerased-as-trump-administration-mulls-defining-sex (NPR)]
